notes: Original named employee schedule only. Board/director, suppliers, Receiver General and below-threshold aggregates excluded. Published remuneration is kept separately from expenses.
Source names and initials retained exactly; repeated disclosed names remain separate observations. No position supplied by the employee schedule.
Dash/blank expenses are unknown and retained null, while printed numeric zeros remain zero. Source chosen remuneration definition is not assumed to be base salary.
Some source names lack a verified surname/given-name separator; matches across years may be incomplete.
